Title: Swim key
WorkoutDescription: NASTY 200's. 200 is the theme of the day, and we build to some stronger sustained efforts here. You might not enjoy this one. WARM UP: 5 x 200 kick with fins on back with 15 sec rest progress effort 1 to 5 MAIN SET: 16 x 200 4 x 200 paddles and ankle strap at 80% 4 x 200 progress 1 to 4 to FAST with 30 sec rest 4 x 200 SBB smooth at 70% 4 x 200 at 80-85% with 15 sec rest 4 x 200 progress 1 to 4 to fast with paddles

Title: High Power Big Gear Strength Work
WorkoutDescription: W/u 20 min Smooth build to Z3/SS 5 min easy spin to get ready M/s 6 x 2 min VO2 - Z5/6 @40/49rpm 2 min easy spin between 5 min easy spin INTO: 15 min Tempo Z3/SS @65/75rpm to finish C/d 5 min easy spin
CoachComments: - Road or TT bike here. - As with any intervals, always start low in the zone and build as legs feel. If using Zwift don't be limited by ERG mode, and use the bias to increase or decrease power, within the set power range. - RPM is king here, hit the correct rpm even at the expense of a little power, have confidence the power will come as you become stronger. - Consume your replacement/recovery products within the 20/30 min finish window.

Title: Run intervals
WorkoutDescription: 10/15 min good building W/u with dynamic stretches and strides 4 x 1200s Build over the first 2 then hold a very strong Z5 pace throughout, 3 min easy walk/jog recovery between 5 mins easy recovery jog INTO 10 mins Tempo Z3/4 to finish 1k easy W/d The goal here is to hit the main set intervals faster than 5k goal race pace!
CoachComments: Semi soft surface prefered if poss or if you struggle with lower limb injuries!! Can easily be transfered onto TM at 2/3% incline!

Title: Swim key
WorkoutDescription: FOCUS: Checkpoint Workout #3 Aim for even pacing and consistent timing. You must keep track with the pace clock to ensure accuracy. We encourage you to keep track of your checkpoint workouts throughout the season. WARM UP: 400 mix of strokes MAIN SET: 16 x 100 with 15 sec rest as: please ensure you take EXACTLY 15 sec rest throughout 2 x 100 smooth and form-focused 2 x 100 build effort over each 100 12 x 100 VERY strong effort. Aim for all the 100's to be close in time. Keep track of your times over the course of your 100's.

Title: 70.3 Build
